title: A golden opportunity: Corporate sustainability reporting as a key lever to address nature-related risks
abstract: Corporate sustainability reporting currently fails to provide the information needed for companies, their investors and society to address mounting environmental risks because predominant reporting requirements focus heavily on firm-level risks, neglecting cumulative impacts on climate and nature. Recently, sustainability reporting has also been critiqued for the administrative burden it places on companies. Corporate reporting may seem far removed from sustainability science but is, in fact, a critical lever in directing corporate practice. A golden opportunity therefore exists for sustainability science to simultaneously help reduce, refine and improve sustainability reporting by identifying the most prioritized mandatory environmental disclosures and support the development of an open-access disclosure repository. This would radically improve the ability of investors, regulators, and public agencies to appraise environmental pressures, improve corporate accountability, and mitigate growing systemic risks. Treating environmental data with the rigor granted to financial data is fundamental to align capital with sustainability objectives.
abstract_zh: 目前，企业可持续发展报告未能提供企业、投资者和社会应对日益加剧的环境风险所需的信息，因为主流的报告要求过分侧重企业层面的风险，而忽视了对气候和自然的累积性影响。近来，可持续发展报告还因给企业带来的行政负担而受到批评。企业报告看似与可持续性科学相距甚远，但实际上它是引导企业实践的关键杠杆。因此，可持续性科学正面临一个难得的机遇：通过识别最为优先的强制性环境披露事项，并支持开放获取披露数据库的建设，同时帮助减少、精简并改进可持续发展报告。这将从根本上提升投资者、监管机构和公共机构评估环境压力、改善企业问责并减轻日益增长的系统性风险的能力。以对待财务数据的严谨态度对待环境数据，是使资本与可持续发展目标相一致的根本所在。

title: Landscape efficiency frontiers for biodiversity, climate mitigation and net economic value
abstract: Balancing biodiversity, climate and economic development means making difficult choices about how land is used. Stephen Polasky, Regents Professor and Fesler-Lampert Professor of Ecological/Environmental Economics at the University of Minnesota, explores the trade-offs between competing demands for land. Meeting biodiversity, climate, and economic development goals requires careful consideration of how to utilize land and the potential tradeoffs among different goals. Land used in one way, such as to grow crops to help meet food demand, cannot also be devoted to another use, such as maintaining natural habitat for biodiversity and increased carbon sequestration.
abstract_zh: 平衡生物多样性、气候与经济发展，意味着需要在土地利用方面做出艰难的选择。明尼苏达大学生态/环境经济学讲席教授（Regents Professor）、费斯勒-兰珀特讲座教授（Fesler-Lampert Professor）Stephen Polasky探讨了土地竞争性需求之间的权衡。实现生物多样性、气候和经济发展目标，需要审慎考虑如何利用土地，以及不同目标之间潜在的取舍。一块土地若用于种植作物以满足粮食需求，就不能同时用于维持生物多样性的自然栖息地或增加碳封存。

title: Linking economic value, trade dynamics and forest loss in global primary wood production
Opportunity and risk in achieving food production and conservation goals at high altitude: Evidence from the Tibetan Plateau
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
The Tibetan Plateau, the Earth’s highest and largest plateau, has a harsh environment for agriculture, and is a global biodiversity hotspot, raising the challenge of simultaneously satisfying food production and conservation goals. Currently, agriculture involves crop production on steep slopes and overgrazing, which threatens future productivity. The Tibetan Plateau is also undergoing climate change. We evaluate food production from 1990 to 2020 and use these results to model future trends and risks to food production on the Tibetan Plateau. We assess the feasibility of achieving both food production and conservation goals simultaneously under climate change scenarios. Food production increased 32.33% over three decades, providing 2,892.98 kcal d
−1
cap
−1
, more than enough to satisfy food self-sufficiency. Under climate change, the Tibetan Plateau will become warmer and wetter under Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) SSP126, SSP245, and SSP585, which combined with agricultural advances (e.g., improved mechanization and irrigation), will likely result in increased yields even with a 10% reduction in cropland area—greater than the total area of all steeply sloping cropland, thereby allowing retirement of steeply sloping cropland and livestock reductions while still meeting food production goals. Meanwhile, key ecosystem services, including carbon sequestration, water retention, and habitat quality, are also projected to improve substantially. Nonetheless, the increasing frequency and severity of extreme weather events are expected to reduce food production, undermine current dietary requirements and may threaten the minimum nutritional intake required for humans.
abstract_zh: 青藏高原是地球上海拔最高、面积最大的高原，其农业环境严酷，同时也是全球生物多样性热点地区，这使得同时实现粮食生产和保护目标面临挑战。目前，农业生产包括在陡坡上种植作物以及过度放牧，这些都威胁着未来的生产力。青藏高原也正经历气候变化。我们评估了1990年至2020年的粮食产量，并利用这些结果对青藏高原未来的粮食生产趋势和风险进行建模。我们评估了在气候变化情景下同时实现粮食生产与保护目标的可行性。三十年间粮食产量增长了32.33%，人均每日提供2892.98千卡热量，超过了粮食自给所需的水平。在共享社会经济路径（SSPs）SSP126、SSP245和SSP585的气候变化情景下，青藏高原将变得更加温暖和湿润；结合农业进步（例如机械化和灌溉的改善），即使耕地面积减少10%（这一面积大于所有陡坡耕地的总面积），产量仍有可能提高，从而允许退出陡坡耕地并减少牲畜数量，同时仍可实现粮食生产目标。与此同时，包括碳封存、水源涵养和栖息地质量在内的关键生态系统服务也预计将大幅改善。尽管如此，极端天气事件的频率和强度增加，预计将降低粮食产量，削弱当前的膳食需求，并可能威胁人类所需的最低营养摄入。

title: Reversing the great degradation of nature by reducing factors related to cropland expansion
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: As one of the main causes of habitat loss, agricultural cropland expansion is a major threat to biodiversity. We analyze past and anticipated future trends in population, per capita crop demand, and crop yield to estimate agricultural cropland requirements globally by 2050 and 2100, assuming moderate levels of climate change. According to a model of “business as usual,” higher-income countries would be expected to show little or no net growth in cropland by the end of the century whereas cropland area could nearly double in lower-income countries. We consider two strategies to reduce global cropland expansion: decreasing per capita crop demand in higher-income countries by eating healthier diets, reducing food waste, and reducing biofuel production, and accelerating economic development in lower-income countries. Economic development in lower-income countries could reduce future cropland requirements via slower population growth, improved crop yield, and higher volumes of global crop trade, which could more than offset rising per capita crop demand. These impacts would far exceed reductions in cropland requirements from decreased crop demand in higher-income countries. Further, by combining accelerated economic development in lower-income countries with reduced crop demand in higher-income countries in tandem with reduced trade friction, global cropland requirements could shrink dramatically by the year 2100. Although economic growth is often considered to work in opposition to environmental conservation, accelerating economic development in lower-income countries would not only help alleviate poverty but could also confer benefits for biodiversity and global climate change.
abstract_zh: 作为栖息地丧失的主要原因之一，农业耕地扩张是生物多样性面临的主要威胁。我们分析了人口、人均作物需求和作物单产的过去及预期未来趋势，以估算在中等程度气候变化假设下，到2050年和2100年全球所需的农业耕地面积。根据“照常发展”（business as usual）模型，高收入国家到本世纪末耕地净增长将很少或没有增长，而低收入国家的耕地面积则可能几乎翻倍。我们考虑了两种减少全球耕地扩张的策略：一是通过健康饮食、减少粮食浪费和减少生物燃料生产，降低高收入国家的人均作物需求；二是加速低收入国家的经济发展。低收入国家的经济发展可以通过放缓人口增长、提高作物单产以及扩大全球作物贸易量，来减少未来的耕地需求，这足以抵消不断上升的人均作物需求。这些影响将远远超过高收入国家减少作物需求所带来的耕地需求削减。此外，将低收入国家加速经济发展与高收入国家减少作物需求相结合，并同时降低贸易摩擦，全球耕地需求到2100年可能大幅缩减。尽管经济增长通常被认为与环境保护相抵触，但加速低收入国家的经济发展不仅有助于缓解贫困，还可能为生物多样性和全球气候变化带来益处。

title: Synergies and trade-offs between energy, climate, and biodiversity from global fuelwood consumption
abstract: Fuelwood remains a major traditional energy source for more than 264 million households worldwide. However, its global impacts on sustainability are poorly quantified. Here, we develop an integrated framework combining energetic, economic, and environmental perspectives to evaluate the livelihood, economic, carbon emission, and biodiversity impacts of global fuelwood consumption from 2000 to 2021 and to project outcomes under alternative energy and management scenarios for 2030 and 2050. We find that global fuelwood consumption reached 1.9 billion m 3 in 2021 (2.5% of primary energy use). The economic value was $190 billion, accounting for 0.2% of global GDP but up to 6.7% in low-income countries. Fuelwood use by all income levels together generated 1.1–1.7 Gt CO 2 emissions and significantly undermined global biodiversity integrity. Counterfactual simulations show that substituting 90% of unsustainably harvested fuelwood with renewable energy could reduce global primary energy emissions by 3.2–4.4% and increase biodiversity integrity by 0.3%. By 2050, policy interventions would markedly improve carbon and biodiversity outcomes. Forest certification reduces emissions by up to 99.7, 98.4, and 74.0% in high-, upper-middle-, and lower-middle-income countries, respectively. In low-income countries, clean energy substitution reduces emissions by 61.3%, while LPG and clean energy scenarios increase biodiversity integrity by up to 65.6% and further improve outcomes in higher-income groups. These findings underscore the importance of systemic approaches that explicitly account for trade-offs and synergies among energy access, livelihoods, carbon mitigation, and biodiversity conservation in fuelwood management.
abstract_zh: 薪柴仍是全球2.64亿多户家庭的主要传统能源。然而，其对全球可持续性的影响尚未得到充分量化。在此，我们构建了一个综合框架，结合能源、经济和环境视角，用以评估2000年至2021年全球薪柴消费对生计、经济、碳排放和生物多样性的影响，并在2030年和2050年的替代能源与管理情景下对结果进行预测。我们发现，2021年全球薪柴消费量达到19亿立方米（占一次能源使用的2.5%）。其经济价值为1900亿美元，占全球GDP的0.2%，但在低收入国家可高达6.7%。各收入水平的薪柴使用合计产生了1.1至1.7吉吨（Gt）二氧化碳排放，并显著损害了全球生物多样性完整性。反事实模拟表明，若以可再生能源替代90%不可持续采伐的薪柴，可使全球一次能源排放减少3.2%至4.4%，并使生物多样性完整性提高0.3%。到2050年，政策干预将显著改善碳排放和生物多样性的结果。在高收入、中上等收入和中下等收入国家，森林认证分别可使排放减少高达99.7%、98.4%和74.0%。在低收入国家，清洁能源替代可使排放减少61.3%；而液化石油气（LPG）和清洁能源情景可使生物多样性完整性提高高达65.6%，并在较高收入群体中进一步改善结果。这些发现强调了系统性方法的重要性，这类方法应明确考虑能源可及性、生计、碳减排和生物多样性保护之间的权衡与协同，以用于薪柴管理。

Earth- economy modeling: Advances in linking economic and ecosystem models
abstract: This article reviews a wide range of models that integrate ecological and economic systems, presenting Earth-Economy (EE) modeling as a general approach for sustainable management in these contexts. EE models combine global, general equilibrium economic models with high-resolution Earth system models and include two-way linkages between Earth systems and the economy, enabling data-focused decision support for sustainability. We conduct a systematic review of models related to this domain, create a typology of relevant models, and discuss the interconnections between them. We include a detailed definition of EE modeling and discuss how the relevant models can be integrated and extended to improve the comprehensiveness with which we model sustainability. This review shows both the importance of and associated challenges, but also the high demand, for this type of model.
abstract_zh: 本文综述了一系列整合生态与经济系统的模型，并将地球—经济（EE）建模作为这些情境下可持续管理的一种通用方法加以介绍。EE模型将全球一般均衡经济模型与高分辨率地球系统模型相结合，包含地球系统与经济之间的双向联系，从而为可持续发展提供以数据为基础的决策支持。我们对该领域的相关模型进行了系统综述，建立了相关模型的类型学，并讨论了它们之间的相互联系。我们给出了EE建模的详细定义，并探讨了如何整合和扩展相关模型，以提高我们对可持续性建模的全面性。本综述既表明了这类模型的重要性和相关挑战，也显示了对其的巨大需求。

title: Predicting the impact of climate change on forest composition, deer, and outdoor recreation using structural equation modeling (SEM) in northeastern Minnesota
Quantifying disturbance effects on ecosystem services in a changing climate
abstract: Disturbances, such as hurricanes, fires, droughts, and pest outbreaks, can cause major changes in ecosystem conditions that threaten nature’s contributions to people (ecosystem services). However, approaches to assess these impacts on diverse services under climate change are rare. To advance such efforts, we build on the accelerating research on disturbance ecology and ecosystem services to develop a functional trait-based approach to quantify ecological, ecosystem service, and economic outcomes under risk and climate change. We demonstrate this general approach by quantifying impacts to ecosystem services—timber and recreational enjoyment—from extreme windstorms in a mid-latitude forest. We find that expected ecosystem service losses from these windstorm disturbances are large and likely to increase with climate change. Yet, we show that common ecological metrics of compositional and biomass stability are inadequate for predicting these impacts to ecosystem service, necessitating more direct measures of services with disturbance. We then illustrate our approach for other applications spanning different ecosystems, services, and disturbances, including crop pollination, flood hazard mitigation, and cultural values. These examples highlight the pressing need to consider disturbances in future ecosystem service assessments, given the increase in mega-disturbances occurring globally with climate change.
abstract_zh: 飓风、火灾、干旱和虫害爆发等扰动，可能引起生态系统状况的重大变化，从而威胁自然对人类的贡献（即生态系统服务）。然而，在气候变化背景下评估这些扰动对多种服务影响的方法十分罕见。为推进此类研究，我们在关于扰动生态学与生态系统服务的快速发展研究基础上，构建了一种基于功能性状的方法，用以量化在风险和气候变化下的生态、生态系统服务及经济结果。我们以中纬度森林中极端风暴扰动对木材和休闲享受这两项生态系统服务的影响为例，展示了这一通用方法。我们发现，风暴扰动造成的生态系统服务损失预计很大，并可能随气候变化而增加。然而，我们表明，常用的群落组成稳定性和生物量稳定性生态指标，不足以预测这些对生态系统服务的影响，因此有必要采用更为直接的服务衡量指标来评估扰动。随后，我们将这一方法应用于其他生态系统、服务和扰动类型，包括作物授粉、洪水灾害缓解以及文化价值。这些例子凸显了在未来生态系统服务评估中考虑扰动的迫切需要，因为随着气候变化，全球范围内的超级扰动正在增加。

title: Refugees and host communities' vulnerability to climate and disaster risks in Rwanda
abstract: Climate change hazards pose significant risks to vulnerable populations, particularly refugees residing in camps within environmentally sensitive areas. This study assesses climate and disaster risks in refugee-hosting districts in Rwanda using GIS-based risk mapping, decision science tools (AHP), remote sensing, and econometric analysis. The findings reveal spatial variability in hazard exposure across camps, with Mahama and Mugombwa refugee camps experiencing the highest flood risks, while Gihembe, Kiziba, and Kigeme camps are most susceptible to landslides. Between 2013 and 2021, landslides resulted in the damage of 324 hectares of cropland in Gihembe district and caused 110 fatalities in Kiziba’s district in 2016 alone. The study also finds that Mahama camp is highly vulnerable to drought, reflecting national data indicating that 4.2 million Rwandans were affected by droughts between 1974 and 2018. In addition, Kiziba camp exhibits severe soil erosion, with up to 19 million tons of annual soil loss in its watershed area. This erosion, exacerbated by deforestation due to firewood harvesting and construction material collection, weakens slope stability, intensifying landslide risks and increasing sediment transport into local water sources, thereby impacting water quality. Our results support recent disaster management decisions by the Government of Rwanda and UNHCR, including the closure of Gihembe camp in 2021 due to landslide risks and the relocation of vulnerable populations from Kigeme camp due to erosion-induced ravine formation. While these interventions reduce immediate risks, continued efforts are needed to enhance camp resilience, strengthen early warning systems, and integrate nature-based solutions into long-term disaster risk management.
abstract_zh: 气候变化带来的灾害对脆弱人群构成重大风险，尤其是居住在生态敏感地区难民营中的难民。本研究利用基于GIS的风险制图、决策科学工具（层次分析法，AHP）、遥感和计量经济分析，评估了卢旺达接收难民地区的气候与灾害风险。研究结果显示，各难民营的灾害暴露存在空间差异：马哈马（Mahama）和穆贡布瓦（Mugombwa）难民营面临的洪水风险最高，而吉赫姆贝（Gihembe）、基齐巴（Kiziba）和基盖姆（Kigeme）难民营则最易发生滑坡。2013年至2021年间，滑坡导致吉赫姆贝地区324公顷耕地受损；仅在2016年，基齐巴地区就有110人因滑坡死亡。研究还发现，马哈马难民营极易受干旱影响，这与国家数据相吻合，后者显示1974年至2018年间有420万卢旺达人受到干旱影响。此外，基齐巴难民营表现出严重的土壤侵蚀，其流域每年土壤流失量高达1900万吨。这种侵蚀因砍伐柴薪和采集建筑材料导致的森林砍伐而加剧，削弱了坡面稳定性，加剧了滑坡风险，并增加了进入当地水源的泥沙输送，从而影响了水质。我们的结果支持了卢旺达政府和联合国难民署近期的灾害管理决策，包括2021年因滑坡风险关闭吉赫姆贝难民营，以及因侵蚀导致冲沟形成而将基盖姆难民营的脆弱人口迁出。虽然这些干预措施降低了眼前的风险，但仍需持续努力，以增强难民营的韧性，加强预警系统，并将基于自然的解决方案纳入长期灾害风险管理。

title: Spatial heterogeneity of carrying capacity on the Tibetan Plateau: An ecosystem service approach

Global yield gap time trends reveal regions at risk of future crop yield stagnation
abstract: Yield gaps, here defined as the difference between actual and attainable yields, provide a framework for assessing opportunities to increase agricultural productivity. Previous global assessments, centred on a single year, were unable to identify temporal variation. Here we provide a spatially and temporally comprehensive analysis of yield gaps for ten major crops from 1975 to 2010. Yield gaps have widened steadily over most areas for the eight annual crops and remained static for sugar cane and oil palm. We developed a three-category typology to differentiate regions of ‘steady growth’ in actual and attainable yields, ‘stalled floor’ where yield is stagnated and ‘ceiling pressure’ where yield gaps are closing. Over 60% of maize area is experiencing ‘steady growth’, in contrast to ∼12% for rice. Rice and wheat have 84% and 56% of area, respectively, experiencing ‘ceiling pressure’. We show that ‘ceiling pressure’ correlates with subsequent yield stagnation, signalling risks for multiple countries currently realizing gains from yield growth.
abstract_zh: 产量差距（yield gap）指实际单产与可达到单产之间的差值，为评估提高农业生产力的机会提供了框架。以往针对单一年份的全球评估，无法识别时间上的变化。本研究对1975年至2010年十种主要作物的产量差距进行了空间和时间上的全面分析。在大多数地区，八种一年生作物的产量差距持续扩大，而甘蔗和油棕的产量差距则基本保持不变。我们提出了三类划分体系，以区分实际单产和可达到单产呈“稳定增长”的地区、单产停滞于“平台期”的地区，以及产量差距正在缩小、单产逼近“天花板压力”的地区。超过60%的玉米种植面积处于“稳定增长”状态，相比之下水稻仅约为12%。水稻和小麦分别有84%和56%的种植面积处于“天花板压力”之下。我们发现，“天花板压力”与随后的单产停滞相关，这意味着当前仍从单产增长中获益的多个国家面临风险。

title: How to make land use policy decisions: Integrating science and economics to deliver connected climate, biodiversity and food objectives. 2024
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract:
Land use change is crucial to addressing the existential threats of climate change and biodiversity loss while enhancing food security [M. Zurek
et al.
,
Science
376
, 1416–1421 (2022)]. The interconnected and spatially varying nature of the impacts of land use change means that these challenges must be addressed simultaneously [H.-O. Pörtner
et al.
,
Science
380
, eabl4881 (2023)]. However, governments commonly focus on single issues, incentivizing land use change via “Flat-Rate” subsidies offering constant per hectare payments, uptake of which is determined by the economic circumstances of landowners rather than the integrated environmental outcomes that will be delivered [G. Q. Bull
et al.
,
Forest Policy Econ.
9
, 13–31 (2006)]. Here, we compare Flat-Rate subsidies to two alternatives: “Land Use Scenario” allocation of subsidies through consultation across stakeholders and interested parties; and a “Natural Capital” approach which targets subsidies according to expected ecosystem service response. This comparison is achieved by developing a comprehensive decision support system, integrating new and existing natural, physical, and economic science models to quantify environmental, agricultural, and economic outcomes. Applying this system to the United Kingdom’s net zero commitment to increase carbon storage via afforestation, we show that the three approaches result in significantly different outcomes in terms of where planting occurs, their environmental consequences, and economic costs and benefits. The Flat-Rate approach actually increases net carbon emissions while Land Use Scenario allocation yields poor economic outcomes. The Natural Capital targeted approach outperforms both alternatives, providing the highest possible social values while satisfying net zero commitments.
abstract_zh: 土地利用变化对于应对气候变化和生物多样性丧失的生存性威胁、同时提升粮食安全至关重要（M. Zurek et al., Science 376, 1416–1421 (2022)）。土地利用变化影响的相互关联性及其空间差异性意味着，必须同时应对这些挑战（H.-O. Pörtner et al., Science 380, eabl4881 (2023)）。然而，各国政府通常只关注单一问题，通过提供每公顷固定补贴的“统一费率”（Flat-Rate）补贴来激励土地利用变化，而补贴的采用取决于土地所有者的经济状况，而非将会产生的综合环境结果（G. Q. Bull et al., Forest Policy Econ. 9, 13–31 (2006)）。在此，我们将统一费率补贴与两种替代方案进行比较：“土地利用情景”（Land Use Scenario）分配方式，即通过利益相关方和相关各方的协商来分配补贴；以及“自然资本”（Natural Capital）方法，即根据预期的生态系统服务响应来确定补贴对象。这一比较是通过开发一个综合决策支持系统实现的，该系统整合了新的和现有的自然、物理和经济科学模型，以量化环境、农业和经济结果。我们将该系统应用于英国通过造林增加碳储存的净零排放承诺，结果表明，三种方法在种植地点、环境后果以及经济成本与收益方面存在显著差异。统一费率方法实际上会增加净碳排放，而土地利用情景分配则带来较差的经济结果。自然资本定向方法优于另外两种方法，在满足净零排放承诺的同时，提供了最高的社会价值。

title: Integrated modeling of nature’s role in human wellbeing: A research agenda
Land-use decisions have substantial air quality health effects
abstract: Understanding how best to use limited land without compromising food security, health, and beneficial ecosystem functions is a critical challenge of our time. Ecosystem service assessments increasingly inform land-use decisions but seldom include the effects of land use on air quality, the largest environmental health risk. Here, we estimate and value the air quality health effects of potential land-use policies and projected trends in the United States, alongside carbon sequestration and economic returns to land, until 2051. We show that air quality health effects are of first-order importance in land-use decisions, often larger in value than carbon sequestration and economic returns combined. When air quality is properly accounted for, policies that appeared beneficial are shown to be detrimental and vice versa. Land-use-driven air quality impacts are largely from agricultural emissions and biogenic forest emissions, although incentives for reduced deforestation remain beneficial overall. Without evaluating air quality, we are unable to determine whether land-use decisions make us better or worse off.
abstract_zh: 如何在不损害粮食安全、健康和有益生态系统功能的前提下，最好地利用有限的土地，是我们这个时代的一项关键挑战。生态系统服务评估日益为土地利用决策提供信息，但很少纳入土地利用对空气质量的影响，而空气质量是最大的环境健康风险。在此，我们估算并评估了美国潜在土地利用政策及预计趋势在2051年之前对空气质量健康的影响，并与碳封存和土地经济回报进行了比较。我们表明，空气质量健康影响在土地利用决策中具有首要重要性，其价值往往超过碳封存和经济回报的总和。当充分考虑空气质量时，那些看似有益的政策会被证明是有害的，反之亦然。土地利用引起的空气质量影响主要来自农业排放和生物源森林排放，尽管减少毁林的激励措施总体上仍然有益。若不评估空气质量，我们将无法判断土地利用决策究竟使我们变得更好还是更糟。

title: Mapping the planet's critical areas for biodiversity and people
abstract: Meeting global commitments to conservation, climate, and sustainable development goals requires consideration of synergies and tradeoffs among targets. We evaluate the spatial congruence of ecosystems providing globally high levels of nature’s contributions to people, biodiversity, and areas with high development potential across several sectors. We find that conserving 44% of global land area through protection or sustainable management could provide 90% of current levels of ten of nature’s contributions to people and meet minimum representation targets for 26,709 terrestrial vertebrate species. This finding supports recent commitments by national governments under the Global Framework for Biodiversity to conserve at least 30% of global lands and waters. More than one-third of areas required for conserving nature’s contributions to people and species are also highly suitable for agriculture, renewable energy, oil and gas, mining, or urban expansion. This indicates potential conflicts among conservation, climate and development goals.
abstract_zh: 要实现全球在保护、气候和可持续发展方面的承诺，需要考虑各目标之间的协同与权衡。我们评估了在多个部门中，提供全球高水平自然对人类贡献（nature’s contributions to people）的生态系统、生物多样性以及具有高开发潜力的区域之间的空间一致性。我们发现，通过保护或可持续管理保护全球44%的陆地面积，可以提供当前十项自然对人类贡献水平的90%，并满足26709种陆生脊椎动物物种的最低代表性目标。这一发现支持了各国政府近期在《全球生物多样性框架》（Global Framework for Biodiversity）下作出的承诺，即保护至少30%的全球陆地和水域。在为保护自然对人类的贡献和物种所需的区域中，超过三分之一同时也非常适合农业、可再生能源、石油和天然气、采矿或城市扩张。这表明保护、气候和发展目标之间存在潜在冲突。

title: Spatial heterogeneity in hedonic price effects for lake water quality
abstract: This study uses Zillow's ZTRAX property transaction database to investigate variation in hedonic price effects of water clarity on single-family houses throughout the United States. We consider five spatial scales and estimate models using different sample selection criteria and model specifications. Our results indicate considerable spatial heterogeneity both within and across the four U.S. Census regions. However, we also find heterogeneity resulting from different types of investigator decisions, including sample selection and modelling choices. Thus, it is necessary to use practical knowledge to consider the limits of market areas and to investigate the robustness of estimation results to investigator choices. (JEL Q51).
abstract_zh: 本研究利用Zillow的ZTRAX房产交易数据库，考察水体透明度对美国各地单户住宅特征价格效应的变异。我们考虑了五种空间尺度，并采用不同的样本筛选标准和模型设定进行估计。结果表明，美国四大人口普查区内部及区域之间均存在显著的空间异质性。然而，我们也发现，研究者的不同决策（包括样本筛选和建模选择）会带来异质性。因此，有必要运用实践知识来界定市场范围的边界，并检验估计结果对研究者选择的稳健性。（JEL Q51）

title: The effect of forest composition on outdoor recreation
The role of transdisciplinary approaches in environmental economics
abstract_zh: 环境和资源挑战的规模与复杂性持续增长。应对这些挑战需要广阔的思维，以制定并实施有效的解决方案。跨学科研究（transdisciplinary research）被视为学科整合的顶峰，为解决复杂问题提供了强有力的方法。在环境经济学背景下，跨学科研究呈现出三个关键主题：（a）跨学科性存在不同程度，这些程度催生了新的涌现性方法，并通过行为和实践的改变实现了在实际中的应用；（b）许多环境经济学研究已表现出跨学科研究的特征，但在许多情况下，跨学科性的某些方面仍有扩展空间；（c）经济学家在应用跨学科方法时面临各种障碍，包括跨学科、个人和制度层面的障碍。尽管跨学科研究有其自身的障碍，但环境经济学家通过探索跨学科思维和方法，在制定与实施解决方案方面可能获得巨大的潜在收益。

title: Titanic lessons for Spaceship Earth: Accounting for human behavior in institutional design
Using structural equation models (SEM) to link climate change, forest composition, deer, and outdoor recreation
Utilizing basic income to create a sustainable poverty-free tomorrow
abstract: The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic of 2020 was a reminder of society's vulnerability in the face of natural upheavals, leading to widespread unemployment and increased poverty. Simultaneously, human activities have precipitated large-scale environmental degradation and catastrophic climate change. Here, we conduct a global-scale, 186-country analysis examining the potential impact of basic income (BI) as a two-pronged solution to both sustainability and social resilience. We reveal BI's potential to bolster economies, particularly in times of crisis. To lower the huge barrier imposed by implementation costs, we suggest a diverse array of strategies aimed at financing BI, strategically designed to concurrently alleviate economic insecurity while fostering nature conservation. We suggest that BI implementation is feasible and could be a potent tool in addressing the twin challenges of decreasing worldwide poverty while reducing environmental degradation—a nexus that arguably constitutes the paramount global challenge of our times.
abstract_zh: 2020年爆发的新型冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行提醒人们，社会在面对自然剧变时十分脆弱，并导致了大范围的失业和贫困加剧。与此同时，人类活动已引发大规模的环境退化和灾难性的气候变化。在此，我们开展了一项覆盖186个国家的全球性分析，考察无条件基本收入（basic income, BI）作为一项兼顾可持续性与社会韧性的双重解决方案的潜在影响。我们揭示了BI在提振经济方面的潜力，尤其是在危机时期。为降低实施成本带来的巨大障碍，我们提出了一系列为BI筹资的多样化策略，这些策略经过战略设计，旨在同时缓解经济不安全状况并促进自然保护。我们认为，BI的实施是可行的，并且可以成为应对双重挑战的有力工具：既要减少全球范围内的贫困，又要减少环境退化——这一关联可以说是我们时代最重大的全球性挑战。

title: Focus on global-local-global analysis of sustainability
Gross ecosystem product (GEP): Quantifying nature for environmental policy innovation
Investing in nature can improve equity and economic returns

title: MOO- GAPS: A Multi-Objective Optimization model for Global Animal Production and Sustainability
abstract: Agricultural and livestock production involves significant trade-offs between multiple sustainable development goals, including reducing hunger and poverty, and reducing emissions of greenhouse gasses. Here we describe a multi-objective optimization tool for livestock production to evaluate trade-offs among environmental and economic objectives with high spatial granularity and the capability to be aggregated to national or global scales. We illustrate the use of this tool analysing how and where to produce beef to optimize the weighted sum of environmental and economic objectives, in this case minimizing greenhouse gas emissions and minimizing costs of production. We present how the outputs of this model can inform a sustainable transition of the industry and policy decisions, with a focus on inherent trade-offs. By comparing optimal production with current production, we highlight the potential environmental and economic efficiencies that can be made by changing the location or methods of production. As such, this tool provides a platform to identify trade-offs and synergies among multiple diverse sustainability goals, critical in the livestock and agricultural sectors.
abstract_zh: 农业和畜牧生产涉及多种可持续发展目标之间的重大权衡，包括减少饥饿和贫困，以及减少温室气体排放。在此，我们描述了一种用于畜牧生产的多目标优化工具，用以评估环境与经济目标之间的权衡，该工具具有高度的空间精细度，并可汇总至国家或全球尺度。我们以分析如何及在何处生产牛肉为例展示了该工具的应用，以优化环境与经济目标的加权和，在本案例中即最小化温室气体排放与最小化生产成本。我们阐述了该模型的输出如何为行业的可持续转型和政策决策提供参考，并重点关注其中固有的权衡。通过将最优生产与当前生产进行比较，我们指出了通过改变生产地点或生产方式可以实现的潜在环境与经济效率提升。因此，该工具为识别多种多样的可持续性目标之间的权衡与协同提供了平台，这对畜牧业和农业部门至关重要。

title: Managing nitrogen in maize production for societal gain
Mapping the planet’s critical natural assets
Navigating sustainability trade-offs in global beef production
Policy collision: A framework to identify where polycentric, multi-objective sustainability solutions are needed
abstract: The exploitation of ecosystem services, through processes like agricultural production, is associated with myriad negative environmental impacts, which are felt by stakeholders on local, regional, and global scales. The varying type and scale of impacts leads naturally to fragmented and siloed approaches to mitigating externalities by diverse governmental and non-governmental institutions. However, policies designed to address a single impact may worsen other negative impacts. As a result, even when groups have the expertise to design policy solutions in one dimension, policies addressing single issues may conflict and result in less than ideal outcomes in combination. In this paper, we present a conceptual framework and examples of this kind of ‘policy collision,’ where policies produce mutual negative interference so that policies designed independently may fail to achieve their goals. We argue that an integrated systems perspective is needed to overcome this problem and present several positive examples where this has been put into practice. Policy collision provides a useful framework for determining how each colliding policy should be modified in improve outcomes.
abstract_zh: 通过农业生产等过程对生态系统服务的开发，会带来诸多负面环境影响，这些影响会在地方、区域和全球各个层面被利益相关者感受到。不同类型和规模的影响，自然导致了各类政府和非政府机构在缓解外部性问题时采取碎片化和割裂化的做法。然而，旨在应对单一影响的政策可能会加剧其他负面影响。因此，即便某些群体具备在某一维度上设计政策方案的专业能力，单一议题的政策也可能相互冲突，在叠加时产生不甚理想的结果。本文提出了一个概念框架，并列举了这种“政策碰撞”（policy collision）的案例：政策之间产生相互负向干扰，使得独立设计的政策可能无法实现其目标。我们认为，需要一种综合的系统视角来克服这一问题，并介绍了若干已将该视角付诸实践的正面案例。政策碰撞框架为确定每项相互冲突的政策应如何调整以改善结果提供了有益的分析框架。

title: Response diversity as a sustainability strategy
Valuing water quality in the US using a national data set on property values
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: High-quality water resources provide a wide range of benefits, but the value of water quality is often not fully represented in environmental policy decisions, due in large part to an absence of water quality valuation estimates at large, policy relevant scales. Using data on property values with nationwide coverage across the contiguous United States, we estimate the benefits of lake water quality as measured through capitalization in housing markets. We find compelling evidence that homeowners place a premium on improved water quality. This premium is largest for lakefront property and decays with distance from the waterbody. In aggregate, we estimate that 10% improvement of water quality for the contiguous United States has a value of $6 to 9 billion to property owners. This study provides credible evidence for policymakers to incorporate lake water quality value estimates in environmental decision-making.
abstract_zh: 高质量的水资源可带来广泛的效益，但由于缺乏大尺度、与政策相关的水质价值估计，水质的价值往往未能在环境政策决策中得到充分体现。利用覆盖美国本土全部地区的房产价值数据，我们通过房屋市场中的资本化效应，估算了湖泊水质改善的效益。我们发现了有力证据表明，房主对水质改善给予溢价。这一溢价在湖滨房产中最大，并随与水体距离的增加而衰减。总体而言，我们估计美国本土水质改善10%，可为房产所有者带来60亿至90亿美元的价值。本研究为政策制定者将湖泊水质价值估计纳入环境决策提供了可靠的证据。

title: Achieving global biodiversity goals by 2050 requires urgent and integrated actions
abstract: Governments are negotiating actions intended to halt biodiversity loss and put it on a path to recovery by 2050. Here, we show that bending the curve for biodiversity is possible, but only if actions are implemented urgently and in an integrated manner. Connecting these actions to biodiversity outcomes and tracking progress remain a challenge.
abstract_zh: 各国政府正在谈判旨在遏制生物多样性丧失、并在2050年前使其走上恢复之路的行动。在此，我们表明，只有在紧急且综合性地实施行动的前提下，扭转生物多样性下降的趋势才是可能的。将这些行动与生物多样性成果相联系，并追踪其进展，仍然是一项挑战。

title: Conservation needs to integrate knowledge across scales
Earth Stewardship: Shaping a sustainable future through interacting policy and norm shifts
abstract: Transformation toward a sustainable future requires an earth stewardship approach to shift society from its current goal of increasing material wealth to a vision of sustaining built, natural, human, and social capital—equitably distributed across society, within and among nations. Widespread concern about earth’s current trajectory and support for actions that would foster more sustainable pathways suggests potential social tipping points in public demand for an earth stewardship vision. Here, we draw on empirical studies and theory to show that movement toward a stewardship vision can be facilitated by changes in either policy incentives or social norms. Our novel contribution is to point out that both norms and incentives must change and can do so interactively. This can be facilitated through leverage points and complementarities across policy areas, based on values, system design, and agency. Potential catalysts include novel democratic institutions and engagement of non-governmental actors, such as businesses, civic leaders, and social movements as agents for redistribution of power. Because no single intervention will transform the world, a key challenge is to align actions to be synergistic, persistent, and scalable.
abstract_zh: 迈向可持续的未来，需要采取地球管家（earth stewardship）的方式，使社会从当前追求物质财富增长的目标，转向维护人造资本、自然资本、人力资本和社会资本的愿景，并在全社会以及各国之间公平分配这些资本。公众对地球当前发展轨迹的广泛担忧，以及对促进更可持续路径的行动的支持，表明在公众对地球管家愿景的需求方面可能存在社会性临界点（social tipping points）。在此，我们借鉴实证研究与理论，表明向管家愿景的转变既可以通过政策激励的改变来推动，也可以通过社会规范的改变来推动。我们的新颖贡献在于指出，规范与激励都必须改变，并且二者可以相互作用地发生改变。通过杠杆点以及跨政策领域的互补性，基于价值观、系统设计和行动主体的推动，这一转变可以得到促进。潜在的催化剂包括新型民主制度，以及非政府行动者的参与，例如企业、社区领袖和社会运动，它们可以作为重新分配权力的主体。由于没有任何单一干预能够改变世界，一项关键挑战在于协调各项行动，使其具有协同性、持久性和可扩展性。

title: Governance in the face of extreme events: Lessons from evolutionary processes for structuring interventions, and the need to go beyond
The Programme on Ecosystem Change and Society (PECS) – a decade of deepening social-ecological research through a place-based focus
abstract: The Programme on Ecosystem Change and Society (PECS) was established in 2011, and is now one of the major international social-ecological systems (SES) research networks. During this time, SES research has undergone a phase of rapid growth and has grown into an influential branch of sustainability science. In this Perspective, we argue that SES research has also deepened over the past decade, and helped to shed light on key dimensions of SES dynamics (e.g. system feedbacks, aspects of system design, goals and paradigms) that can lead to tangible action for solving the major sustainability challenges of our time. We suggest four ways in which the growth of place-based SES research, fostered by networks such as PECS, has contributed to these developments, namely by: 1) shedding light on transformational change, 2) revealing the social dynamics shaping SES, 3) bringing together diverse types of knowledge, and 4) encouraging reflexive researchers.
abstract_zh: 生态系统变化与社会项目（Programme on Ecosystem Change and Society, PECS）成立于2011年，目前已成为主要的国际社会—生态系统（SES）研究网络之一。在此期间，社会—生态系统研究经历了快速增长的阶段，并已发展为可持续性科学中具有影响力的分支。在本观点文章中，我们认为，过去十年间社会—生态系统研究也不断深化，并有助于阐明社会—生态系统动态的关键维度（例如系统反馈、系统设计方面、目标与范式），这些维度可以转化为解决当代重大可持续性挑战的切实行动。我们提出了基于地方的社会—生态系统研究增长促成上述发展的四种途径，即：1）揭示转型性变化；2）揭示塑造社会—生态系统的社会动力；3）汇集多种类型的知识；4）鼓励研究者进行反思。

title: The hidden value of trees: quantifying the ecosystem services of tree lineages and their major threats across the contiguous US
abstract: Trees provide critical contributions to human well-being. They sequester and store greenhouse gasses, filter air pollutants, provide wood, food, and other products, among other benefits. These benefits are threatened by climate change, fires, pests and pathogens. To quantify the current value of the flow of ecosystem services from U.S. trees, and the threats they face, we combine macroevolutionary and economic valuation approaches using spatially explicit data about tree species and lineages. We find that the value of five key ecosystem services with adequate data generated by US trees is $114 billion per annum (low: $85 B; high: $137 B; 2010 USD). The non-market value of trees from carbon storage and air pollution removal far exceed their commercial value from wood products and food crops. Two lineages—pines and oaks—account for 42% of the value of these services. The majority of species face threats from climate change, many face increasing fire risk, and known pests and pathogens threaten 40% of total woody biomass. The most valuable US tree species and lineages are among those most threatened by known pests and pathogens, with species most valuable for carbon storage most at risk from increasing fire threat. High turnover of tree species across the continent results in a diverse set of species distributed across the tree of life contributing to ecosystem services in the U.S. The high diversity of taxa across U.S. forests may be important in buffering ecosystem service losses if and when the most valuable lineages are compromised.
abstract_zh: 树木对人类福祉作出了关键贡献。它们吸收并储存温室气体，过滤空气污染物，提供木材、食物及其他产品，还有其他诸多益处。这些益处正受到气候变化、火灾、害虫和病原体的威胁。为量化美国树木所提供生态系统服务流的当前价值及其面临的威胁，我们结合宏观进化与经济估值方法，利用关于树种和谱系的空间明确数据进行分析。我们发现，美国树木提供的、数据充分的五项关键生态系统服务价值为每年1140亿美元（低值：850亿美元；高值：1370亿美元；2010年美元）。树木在碳储存和空气污染去除方面的非市场价值，远超其在木材产品和粮食作物方面的商业价值。松树和栎树两个谱系占这些服务价值的42%。大多数物种面临气候变化的威胁，许多物种面临日益增加的火灾风险，而已知的害虫和病原体威胁着木本生物量总量的40%。美国最有价值的树种和谱系，恰恰也是受已知害虫和病原体威胁最大的那些，而对碳储存最为重要的物种，则面临火灾威胁增加的最大风险。全大陆树种的高度更替，使得分布于生命之树各个分支上的多样化物种共同为美国的生态系统服务作出贡献。美国森林中丰富的类群多样性，在最有价值的谱系受到损害时，可能对缓冲生态系统服务的损失起到重要作用。

abstract: Discounting plays a central role in decisions about global environmental change that affect the well-being of future generations. Discounting the future more heavily tilts decisions toward the present, making it less likely that society will undertake actions to mitigate climate change or other global environmental change. This article reviews the standard economics approach to discounting that emerges from solving for optimal savings and investment through time. Discounting depends on the pure rate of time preference and differences in consumption levels across time, giving rise to different marginal utilities of consumption. Discounting for problems like climate change that impact future generations involves an ethical dimension. This article includes discussions of ethical dimensions of discounting related to intragenerational and intergenerational equity and also covers behavioral economics, ecological economics, and mainstream economics approaches to discounting. The article closes with a review of the debates over discounting in climate change policy.
abstract_zh: 贴现在涉及影响后代福祉的全球环境变化的决策中发挥着核心作用。对未来进行更高的贴现，会使决策偏向当下，从而降低社会采取行动减缓气候变化或其他全球环境变化的可能性。本文回顾了由求解最优储蓄与投资的跨期路径所得出的标准经济学贴现方法。贴现取决于纯粹时间偏好率以及不同时期消费水平的差异，由此产生了不同的消费边际效用。对于气候变化等影响后代的问题，贴现还涉及伦理维度。本文讨论了贴现中与代内公平和代际公平相关的伦理维度，并涵盖行为经济学、生态经济学和主流经济学对贴现的研究视角。文章最后回顾了气候变化政策中关于贴现的争论。

title: Energy matters: Mitigating the impacts of future land expansion will require managing energy and extractive footprints
abstract: Understanding potential future patterns of human-induced land-use and land-cover change is critical to assessing and proactively managing the tradeoffs between development and the environment. Most global land-use change assessments, however, consider a narrow set of economic sectors, focusing primarily on agricultural and urban sectors. We present a global land-use change model that includes detailed energy and mining sectors (11 in total) in addition to agriculture and urban sectors. We find that energy and extractive sectors had a large expansion footprint (1.26 million km2) projected to 2050, which was nearly as large as the cropland expansion footprint (1.54 million km2) and larger than the urban expansion footprint (0.34 million km2). Moreover, energy and mining expansion account for nearly 80% of all projected expansion into the world's most intact natural lands, suggesting that these sectors play an outsized role in threats to biodiversity and environmental protection. Additionally, we find substantial shifts in the ranking of countries in relation to their vulnerability of land conversion when we accounted for energy and mining footprints alongside agricultural and urban footprints. Our results suggest that meeting resource demands, while maintaining social and environmental benefits provided by natural systems, will require reducing consumption and increasing efficiency in resource use alongside improved development siting and mitigation practices.
abstract_zh: 理解人类活动引起的土地利用和土地覆被变化的未来潜在格局，对于评估和主动管理发展与环境之间的权衡至关重要。然而，大多数全球土地利用变化评估只考虑少数经济部门，主要集中于农业和城市部门。我们提出了一个全球土地利用变化模型，除农业和城市部门外，还包括详细的能源和采矿部门（共11个）。我们发现，能源和采掘部门的扩张足迹较大，预计到2050年将达到126万平方千米，这一数字几乎与耕地扩张足迹（154万平方千米）相当，并且大于城市扩张足迹（34万平方千米）。此外，能源和采矿扩张约占预计进入世界上最完整自然土地的全部扩张的80%，表明这些部门在对生物多样性和环境保护的威胁中发挥着不成比例的作用。另外，当我们将能源和采矿足迹与农业和城市足迹一并纳入考虑时，各国在土地转换脆弱性方面的排名发生了显著变化。我们的结果表明，要满足资源需求，同时维持自然系统所提供的社会和环境效益，需要减少消费、提高资源利用效率，并改进发展选址和缓解措施。

Protecting local water quality has global benefits
abstract: Surface water is among Earth’s most important resources. Yet, benefit–cost studies often report that the costs of water quality protection exceed its benefits. One possible reason for this seeming paradox is that often only a narrow range of local water quality benefits are considered. In particular, the climate damages from water pollution have rarely been quantified. Recent advances in global water science allow the computation of the global methane emission from lakes caused by human nutrient enrichment (eutrophication). Here, we estimate the present value of the global social cost of eutrophication-driven methane emissions from lakes between 2015 and 2050 to be $7.5–$81 trillion (2015 $US), and in a case-study for one well-studied lake (Lake Erie) we find the global value of avoiding eutrophication exceeds local values of either beach use or sport fishing by 10-fold.
abstract_zh: 地表水是地球上最重要的资源之一。然而，成本效益研究常常表明，水质保护的成本超过其效益。这一看似矛盾的一个可能原因是，通常只考虑了狭隘范围内的局部水质效益。特别地，水污染造成的气候损害很少被量化。全球水科学的最新进展使得计算由人为营养物富集（富营养化）导致的湖泊全球甲烷排放成为可能。在此，我们估计，2015至2050年间由富营养化驱动的湖泊甲烷排放的全球社会成本现值为7.5万亿至81万亿美元（2015年美元）。在伊利湖这一研究充分的湖泊案例研究中，我们发现避免富营养化的全球价值，超过了海滩使用或垂钓的当地价值十倍。

title: Spatial priorities for biodiversity and ecosystem services considering theoretical decision-makers' attitudes to risk
abstract: Choosing appropriate spatial priorities for protected areas (PAs) to conserve ecosystem services (ESs) and biodiversity is a challenge for decision makers under limited land resources, especially when facing uncertain protection consequences or conflicting protection objectives. Attitudes toward risk will influence actions, which will, in turn, impact consequences. To understand how theoretical decision-makers’ attitudes towards risk impact protection effectiveness for biodiversity and ESs (e.g., water retention, soil retention, flood mitigation, water purification and carbon sequestration) and how this information can be integrated into effective PAs management, we examined Hainan Island as a case study. We used the ordered weighted averaging (OWA) algorithm to assess the impact of attitude towards risk in PA management. Decision-makers’ attitude towards risk scenarios (from risk-averse and risk-taking) showed higher mean protection effectiveness (2.41–2.85) than existing PAs (2.37), indicating that there is still room for improvement in biodiversity and ESs conservation in existing PAs. In addition, among the seven examined risk scenarios, the higher risk aversion scenario showed the best outcome. In comparison to existing PAs, this scenario improved mean protection effectiveness (20.13%) as well as the protection effectiveness of water retention (24.84%), water purification (11.46%), flood mitigation (8.84%), soil retention (16.63%), carbon sequestration (5.31%), and biodiversity (12.84%). Thus, our research shows that the influence of theoretical decision-makers’ attitudes towards risk could be considered by OWA method which could provide a normative model of what the right choice given theoretical risk attitudes is while selecting priority area for biodiversity and ESs.
abstract_zh: 在土地资源有限的条件下，为保护生态系统服务（ESs）和生物多样性选择适当的保护区（PAs）空间优先区域，对决策者而言是一项挑战，尤其是在保护结果不确定或保护目标相互冲突的情况下。风险态度会影响行动，进而影响结果。为了理解理论决策者的风险态度如何影响生物多样性和生态系统服务（例如水源涵养、土壤保持、防洪、水质净化和碳封存）的保护成效，并探讨如何将这些信息纳入有效的保护区管理，我们以海南岛为案例进行了研究。我们采用有序加权平均（OWA）算法，评估风险态度对保护区管理的影响。决策者的风险态度情景（从风险规避到风险偏好）所显示的平均保护成效（2.41–2.85）高于现有保护区（2.37），表明现有保护区在生物多样性和生态系统服务保护方面仍有改进空间。此外，在所考察的七种风险情景中，风险规避程度最高的情景效果最好。与现有保护区相比，该情景使平均保护成效提高了20.13%，同时使水源涵养（24.84%）、水质净化（11.46%）、防洪（8.84%）、土壤保持（16.63%）、碳封存（5.31%）和生物多样性（12.84%）的保护成效也有所提高。因此，我们的研究表明，理论决策者的风险态度影响可以通过OWA方法加以考虑，该方法能够为在理论风险态度下选择生物多样性和生态系统服务的优先区域提供规范性的最佳选择模型。

Ecosystem restoration on Hainan Island: Can we optimize for enhancing regulating services and poverty alleviation? Environmental Research Letters
abstract: The restoration of ecosystems provides an important opportunity to improve the provision of ecosystem services. Achieving the maximum possible benefits from restoration with a limited budget requires knowing which places if restored would produce the best combination of improved ecosystem services. Using an ecosystem services assessment and optimization algorithm, we find choices that generate maximum benefits from ecosystem restoration. We applied a set of weights to integrate multiple services into a unified approach and find the optimal land restoration option given those weights. We then systematically vary the weights to find a Pareto frontier that shows potentially optimal choices and illustrates trade-offs among services. We applied this process to evaluate optimal restoration on Hainan Island, China, a tropical island characterized by multiple ecosystem service hotspots and conditions of poverty. We analyzed restoration opportunities with the goal of increasing a provisioning service, plantation revenue, and several water-related ecosystem services that contribute to improved water quality and flood mitigation. We found obvious spatial inconsistencies in the optimal location for maximizing separate services and tradeoffs in the provision of these services. Optimized land-use patterns greatly out-performed the non-target restoration scheme. When explicit consideration of the importance of poverty alleviation was taken into account, the location of the prioritized areas shifted and trade-offs among services varied. Our study emphasizes the importance of integrating social concerns into land-use planning to mitigate conflicts and improve equity, especially in the areas where poverty and hotspots of biodiversity and ecosystem services are highly geographically coincident.
abstract_zh: 生态系统恢复为改善生态系统服务的供给提供了重要机遇。在有限预算下实现恢复的最大可能效益，需要了解哪些地点一旦恢复，能够产生生态系统服务改善的最佳组合。我们利用生态系统服务评估和优化算法，找到能够产生生态系统恢复最大效益的选择。我们对一组权重进行设定，以将多种服务整合为统一的方法，并找出在这些权重下最优的土地恢复方案。随后，我们系统地改变权重，以找到帕累托前沿（Pareto frontier），该前沿展示了潜在的最优选择，并说明服务之间的权衡。我们将这一过程应用于中国海南岛的最优恢复评估。海南岛是一个具有多个生态系统服务热点区域，同时面临贫困问题的热带岛屿。我们分析了以提高供给服务（人工林收益）以及若干与水相关的生态系统服务（有助于改善水质和缓解洪水）为目标的恢复机会。我们发现，分别最大化各项服务的最优位置存在明显的空间不一致性，并且各项服务的供给之间存在权衡。优化后的土地利用格局显著优于非目标恢复方案。当充分考虑减贫的重要性时，优先区域的位置发生了变化，服务之间的权衡也随之变化。我们的研究强调，将社会关切纳入土地利用规划的重要性，以减少冲突并促进公平，尤其是在贫困与生物多样性和生态系统服务热点高度地理重叠的地区。

title: Ecosystem services of earth’s largest freshwater lakes
abstract: Fresh water is distributed unevenly across the globe. Earth’s 21 largest lakes hold ~2/3 of all global, liquid, surface, fresh water and occupy diverse ecological and social settings. We identified seven ecosystem services for which there were quantitative data across most or all of these large lakes. Approximately 1.35 million tonnes of fish are harvested per year from these lakes by commercial or artisanal means, with approximately 95% of this harvest coming from the African large lakes. The 21 lakes support the generation of at least 62.2 GW of power and the transportation of 195 million tonnes/year of cargo, with the Laurentian Great Lakes especially important in those. More than five billion m3 of potable drinking water is treated annually from large lakes, and an additional 812 million m3 water per year is extracted for irrigation purposes. The pattern of services provided to humans by large lakes differs based on social and environmental settings. While we assembled systematic data on some important ecosystem services from large lakes, many other important, especially non-commercial services could not similarly be examined due to lack of data. More work is needed to show the value of the full set of ecosystem services provided by large lakes.
abstract_zh: 淡水在全球范围内分布不均。地球上最大的21个湖泊拥有全球液态地表淡水的约2/3，它们处于多样的生态和社会环境之中。我们确定了在这些大型湖泊中大多数或全部都有定量数据的七类生态系统服务。每年约有135万吨鱼类通过商业或小规模手工方式从这些湖泊中捕获，其中约95%来自非洲大湖区。这21个湖泊至少支持了62.2吉瓦（GW）的发电能力，并承担着每年1.95亿吨货物的运输，其中五大湖尤为重要。每年从大型湖泊中处理的可饮用水超过50亿立方米，另有每年8.12亿立方米的水被抽取用于灌溉。湖泊向人类提供的服务模式，因社会和环境条件的不同而有所差异。尽管我们汇集了大型湖泊部分重要生态系统服务的系统数据，但由于缺乏数据，许多其他重要的、尤其是非商业性的服务无法得到同样的考察。要展示大型湖泊所提供的全部生态系统服务的价值，还需要开展更多工作。

Reducing mortality from air pollution in the United States by targeting specific emission sources
abstract: Air quality in the United States has dramatically improved, yet exposure to air pollution is still associated with 100000–200000 deaths annually. Reducing the number of deaths effectively, efficiently, and equitably relies on attributing them to specific emission sources, but so far, this has been done for only highly aggregated groups of sources, or a select few sources of interest. Here, we estimate mortality in the United States attributable to all domestic, human-caused emissions of primary PM2.5 and secondary PM2.5 precursors. We present detailed source-specific attributions in four alternate groupings relevant for identifying promising ways to reduce mortality. We find that nearly half of the deaths can be attributed to just five activities, all in different sectors. Around half of the deaths can be attributed to fossil fuel combustion, with the remainder attributable to combustion of nonfossil fuels, agricultural processes, and other noncombustion processes. Both primary and secondary PM2.5 are important, including PM2.5 from currently unregulated precursor pollutants such as ammonia. We suggest improvements in air quality can be realized by continued reductions of emissions from traditionally important sources and by novel strategies for reducing emissions from sources of emerging relative importance and research focus. Such changes can contribute to improved health outcomes and other environmental goals.
abstract_zh: 尽管美国的空气质量已显著改善，但空气污染暴露每年仍与10万至20万例死亡相关。要有效、高效且公平地减少死亡人数，依赖于将死亡归因于具体的排放源，但迄今为止，这一工作仅针对高度聚合的排放源群体，或少数备受关注的排放源开展。本文估算了美国因所有国内人为一次PM2.5和二次PM2.5前体物排放所导致的死亡人数。我们以四种不同的分组方式，给出了与识别降低死亡率的有效途径相关的、详细的分排放源归因结果。我们发现，近一半的死亡可归因于仅五类活动，且这五类活动分属不同部门。约一半的死亡可归因于化石燃料燃烧，其余则归因于非化石燃料燃烧、农业过程以及其他非燃烧过程。一次PM2.5和二次PM2.5均很重要，其中包括来自目前未受管制的前体污染物（如氨）所产生的PM2.5。我们认为，空气质量的改善可以通过持续削减传统上重要排放源的排放，以及通过针对相对重要性日益上升、且日益受到研究关注的排放源，采取新颖的减排策略来实现。此类变化有助于改善健康结果并实现其他环境目标。

Using Gross Ecosystem Product (GEP) to value nature in decision-making
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Gross domestic product (GDP) summarizes a vast amount of economic information in a single monetary metric that is widely used by decision makers around the world. However, GDP fails to capture fully the contributions of nature to economic activity and human well-being. To address this critical omission, we develop a measure of gross ecosystem product (GEP) that summarizes the value of ecosystem services in a single monetary metric. We illustrate the measurement of GEP through an application to the Chinese province of Qinghai, showing that the approach is tractable using available data. Known as the “water tower of Asia,” Qinghai is the source of the Mekong, Yangtze, and Yellow Rivers, and indeed, we find that water-related ecosystem services make up nearly two-thirds of the value of GEP for Qinghai. Importantly most of these benefits accrue downstream. In Qinghai, GEP was greater than GDP in 2000 and three-fourths as large as GDP in 2015 as its market economy grew. Large-scale investment in restoration resulted in improvements in the flows of ecosystem services measured in GEP (127.5%) over this period. Going forward, China is using GEP in decision making in multiple ways, as part of a transformation to inclusive, green growth. This includes investing in conservation of ecosystem assets to secure provision of ecosystem services through transregional compensation payments.
abstract_zh: 国内生产总值（GDP）将大量经济信息汇总为单一的货币指标，被世界各地的决策者广泛使用。然而，GDP未能充分反映自然对经济活动和人类福祉的贡献。为弥补这一关键缺失，我们开发了一种生态系统生产总值（gross ecosystem product, GEP）指标，将生态系统服务的价值汇总为单一的货币指标。我们以中国青海省为应用案例说明了GEP的测算，表明该方法利用现有数据是可行的。青海被称为“亚洲水塔”，是湄公河、长江和黄河的发源地。我们发现，与水相关的生态系统服务约占青海GEP价值的三分之二。重要的是，这些收益大部分流向下游。在青海，GEP在2000年高于GDP，而到2015年随着市场经济增长，GEP约为GDP的四分之三。在此期间，大规模的恢复投资使以GEP衡量的生态系统服务流量得到改善（增长127.5%）。展望未来，中国正在多种方式中运用GEP进行决策，以此作为向包容性绿色增长转型的一部分。这包括投资于生态系统资产的保护，通过跨区域补偿支付来保障生态系统服务的供给。

title: Optimizing wetland restoration to improve water quality at a regional scale
abstract: Excessive phosphorus (P) export to aquatic ecosystems can lead to impaired water quality. There is a growing interest among watershed managers in using restored wetlands to retain P from agricultural landscapes and improve water quality. We develop a novel framework for prioritizing wetland restoration at a regional scale. The framework uses an ecosystem service model and an optimization algorithm that maximizes P reduction for given levels of restoration cost. Applying our framework in the Lake Champlain Basin, we find that wetland restoration can reduce P export by 2.6% for a budget of $50 M and 5.1% for a budget of $200 M. Sensitivity analysis shows that using finer spatial resolution data for P sources results in twice the P reduction benefits at a similar cost by capturing hot-spots on the landscape. We identify 890 wetlands that occur in more than 75% of all optimal scenarios and represent priorities for restoration. Most of these wetlands are smaller than 7 ha with contributing area less than 100 ha and are located within 200 m of streams. Our approach provides a simple yet robust tool for targeting restoration efforts at regional scales and is readily adaptable to other restoration strategies.
abstract_zh: 水生生态系统中过量的磷（P）输出会导致水质受损。流域管理者对利用恢复的湿地来截留农业景观中的磷、改善水质的兴趣日益浓厚。我们开发了一个在区域尺度上确定湿地恢复优先顺序的新框架。该框架使用生态系统服务模型和优化算法，在给定恢复成本水平下实现磷减排最大化。我们将该框架应用于尚普兰湖流域（Lake Champlain Basin），发现湿地恢复在5000万美元预算下可使磷输出减少2.6%，在2亿美元预算下可减少5.1%。敏感性分析表明，使用更精细空间分辨率的磷源数据，可在相近成本下带来两倍的磷减排效益，因为其能够捕捉景观中的热点区域。我们确定了890处在所有最优情景中超过75%出现的湿地，它们是恢复的优先对象。这些湿地大多面积小于7公顷，汇水面积小于100公顷，并且位于距离溪流200米以内。我们的方法为区域尺度上的恢复工作提供了一个简单而稳健的工具，并且可以方便地应用于其他恢复策略。

title: Assessing nature’s contributions to people
Balancing tradeoffs: Reconciling multiple environmental goals when ecosystem services vary regionally
Benefit relevant indicators: Ecosystem services measures that link ecological and social outcomes
abstract: There is a growing movement in government, environmental non-governmental organizations and the private sector to include ecosystem services in decision making. Adding ecosystem services into assessments implies measuring how much a change in ecological conditions affects people, social benefit, or value to society. Despite consensus around the general merit of accounting for ecosystem services, systematic guidance on what to measure and how is lacking. Current ecosystem services assessments often resort to biophysical proxies (e.g., area of wetland in a floodplain) or even disregard services that seem difficult to measure. Valuation, an important tool for assessing trade-offs and comparing outcomes, is also frequently omitted due to lack of data on social preferences, lack of expertise with valuation methods, or mistrust of valuation methods for non-market services. To address these shortcomings, we propose the use of a new type of indicator that explicitly reflects an ecosystem’s capacity to provide benefits to society, ensuring that ecosystem services assessments measure outcomes that are demonstrably and directly relevant to human welfare. We call these Benefit-relevant indicators (BRIs) and describe a process for developing them using causal chains that link management decisions through ecological responses to effects on human well-being. BRIs identify what is valued and by whom, but stop short of valuation. A BRI for the ability of wetlands to ameliorate flooding would connect measures of the quantity and quality of wetland in a floodplain, as affected by wetlands management decisions, to the number of people or properties downstream that are vulnerable to flooding. BRIs can support monetary or non-monetary valuation, but are particularly useful when valuation will not be conducted; in such cases they serve as stand-alone measures of “what is valued” by particular beneficiaries. BRIs are valid measures of ecosystem services in that they are directly linked to human well-being. Flexibility in the development of BRIs helps to ensure that they are broadly applicable across practitioner and stakeholder communities and decision contexts.
abstract_zh: 政府、环保非政府组织和私营部门中，将生态系统服务纳入决策的趋势日益增长。将生态系统服务纳入评估，意味着需要衡量生态条件的变化在多大程度上影响人们、社会福利或社会价值。尽管人们普遍认同考虑生态系统服务的总体价值，但关于应测量什么以及如何测量的系统性指导仍然缺乏。目前的生态系统服务评估往往依赖生物物理替代指标（例如洪泛平原的湿地面积），甚至忽略那些看似难以测量的服务。估值是评估权衡和比较结果的重要工具，但由于缺乏社会偏好数据、缺乏估值方法的专业知识，或对非市场服务估值方法的不信任，估值也经常被省略。为解决这些不足，我们提出使用一类新的指标，该指标明确反映生态系统向社会提供惠益的能力，从而确保生态系统服务评估衡量的结果与人类福利具有明确且直接的相关性。我们将其称为“惠益相关指标”（Benefit-relevant indicators, BRIs），并描述了利用因果链来开发这些指标的过程，该因果链将管理决策通过生态响应与对人类福祉的影响联系起来。BRIs明确了什么是被重视的，以及由谁重视，但止于估值之前。例如，衡量湿地缓解洪水能力的BRI，将把受湿地管理决策影响的洪泛平原湿地数量和质量，与下游易受洪水影响的人口或财产数量联系起来。BRIs可以支持货币或非货币估值，但在不进行估值的情况下尤为有用；在这种情况下，它们可作为特定受益人所重视事物的独立衡量指标。BRIs之所以是有效的生态系统服务衡量指标，是因为它们与人类福祉直接相关。BRIs开发的灵活性有助于确保其能够广泛适用于不同的实践者和利益相关方社群以及决策情境。

title: Evidence-based causal chains for linking health, development and conservation action
abstract: Sustainability challenges for nature and people are complex and interconnected, such that effective solutions require approaches and a common theory of change that bridge disparate disciplines and sectors. Causal chains offer promising approaches to achieving an integrated understanding of how actions affect ecosystems, the goods and services they provide, and ultimately, human well-being. Although causal chains and their variants are common tools across disciplines, their use remains highly inconsistent, limiting their ability to support and create a shared evidence base for joint actions. In this article, we present the foundational concepts and guidance of causal chains linking disciplines and sectors that do not often intersect to elucidate the effects of actions on ecosystems and society. We further discuss considerations for establishing and implementing causal chains, including nonlinearity, trade-offs and synergies, heterogeneity, scale, and confounding factors. Finally, we highlight the science, practice, and policy implications of causal chains to address real-world linked human-nature challenges.
abstract_zh: 自然与人类所面临的可持续性挑战是复杂且相互关联的，因此有效的解决方案需要采用能够连接不同学科和部门的方法，并形成共同的变革理论（theory of change）。因果链为整合理解行动如何影响生态系统、其提供的商品和服务，以及最终人类福祉，提供了有前景的方法。尽管因果链及其各种变体是跨学科的常用工具，但其使用方式仍然高度不一致，限制了它们支持并建立共同证据基础以推动联合行动的能力。在本文中，我们提出了连接那些通常不相交的学科和部门的因果链的基础概念和指导原则，以阐明行动对生态系统和社会的影响。我们进一步讨论了建立和实施因果链时需要考虑的因素，包括非线性、权衡与协同、异质性、尺度以及混杂因素。最后，我们强调了因果链在应对现实世界中人与自然相互联系的挑战时，对科学、实践和政策的意义。

title: Grassland biodiversity can pay
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Ecological research suggests that greater biodiversity could lead to greater economic value, even for private owners of “working” land. However, the studies from which such a conclusion might be inferred do not account for all relevant information in a coherent economic framework. Our paper applies standard economic theory to rigorously account for costs, quality, and risk. Results indicate that higher levels of biodiversity than are typically observed on commercial grasslands would maximize landowner value in the experimental grassland we study. Greater private benefits from biodiversity could encourage private investment in biodiversity and reduce the cost of public conservation efforts.
abstract_zh: 生态学研究表明，更高的生物多样性可能带来更大的经济价值，甚至对于“从事生产”的土地私人所有者也是如此。然而，得出这一结论所依据的研究，并未在一个连贯的经济框架内考虑所有相关信息。本文运用标准经济学理论，严谨地核算了成本、质量和风险。结果表明，在我们所研究的实验草地上，比商业草地通常所观察到的更高的生物多样性水平，将使土地所有者的价值最大化。私人从生物多样性中获得的更大收益，可能会鼓励私人对生物多样性的投资，并降低公共保护工作的成本。

title: Reconciling corruption with conservation triage: Should investments shift from the last best places? PLoS Biology
abstract: Considerable outside funding will be required to overcome the financial shortfalls faced by most of Africa's protected areas. Given limited levels of external support, it will be essential to allocate these funds wisely. While most recent studies on conservation triage have recommended prioritizing reserves with the highest remaining conservation value (the "last best places"), such investments are complicated by the fact that these same reserves often attract the greatest revenues from ecotourism and thus the most attention from corrupt local governments. Alternatively, philanthropic organizations might achieve greater returns from investing in the management of neglected areas with lower current conservation value but with less financial leakage from corruption. We outline here how high levels of corruption could favor a strategy that shifts investments away from the last best places.
abstract_zh: 大量外部资金是克服非洲大多数保护区财务缺口所必需的。鉴于外部支持有限，将这些资金明智地配置至关重要。尽管近期关于保护分诊（conservation triage）的研究大多建议优先保护剩余保护价值最高的保护区（即“最佳地点”），但此类投资存在一个复杂之处：这些保护区往往也吸引了最多的生态旅游收入，因而也最容易引起腐败地方政府的关注。另一种思路是，慈善组织投资于管理那些当前保护价值较低、但因腐败造成的资金流失较少的被忽视地区，可能获得更大的回报。我们在此阐述，高水平的腐败如何有利于一种将投资从“最佳地点”转移出去的策略。

title: U.S. urban water prices: Cheaper when drier
abstract: Public water utilities are called upon to address multiple and often partially conflicting objectives, allocating potentially scarce water in an efficient and equitable manner while covering the costs of water supply. Economists typically advocate using prices to balance supply and demand of a scarce resource. But high prices necessary to balance supply and demand for scarce water may unduly burden poor households. We analyze the pricing policy of public water utilities in the major city of the 35 largest metropolitan areas in the United States. We would expect water prices to be higher in water‐stressed regions. However, we find the opposite pattern in the data: cities facing greater water scarcity tend to have lower water prices. Sacramento, Las Vegas, and Phoenix, have the lowest water prices. To address equity and ensure that all households have access to water, we would expect low prices on essential water use with higher prices for additional water beyond essential use. However, we find that the majority of cities have higher per unit water prices (average price) for low use than for high use. Such pricing may leave major urban areas in the United States ill‐prepared to meet future water shortages in an equitable manner.
abstract_zh: 公共水务公司需要应对多重且往往部分相互冲突的目标：在有限的水资源分配中兼顾效率与公平，同时弥补供水成本。经济学家通常主张用价格来平衡稀缺资源的供需。但为平衡稀缺水资源的供需所需的高价格，可能给贫困家庭带来不当负担。我们分析了美国35个最大都市区中主要城市的公共水务公司定价政策。我们原本预期，水资源压力较大地区的水价应更高。然而数据呈现出相反的格局：水资源短缺程度较高的城市，水价往往反而较低。萨克拉门托、拉斯维加斯和凤凰城的水价最低。为兼顾公平、确保所有家庭都能获得水资源，我们预期基本用水应适用低价，超出基本用水的部分则应收取更高价格。然而，我们发现大多数城市的低用水量单位均价（平均价格）高于高用水量的单位均价。这种定价方式可能使美国主要城市地区在以公平方式应对未来水资源短缺时准备不足。

abstract: International corporations in an increasingly globalized economy exert a major influence on the planet’s land use and resources through their product design and material sourcing decisions. Many companies use life cycle assessment (LCA) to evaluate their sustainability, yet commonly-used LCA methodologies lack the spatial resolution and predictive ecological information to reveal key impacts on climate, water and biodiversity. We present advances for LCA that integrate spatially explicit modelling of land change and ecosystem services in a Land-Use Change Improved (LUCI)-LCA. Comparing increased demand for bioplastics derived from two alternative feedstock-location scenarios for maize and sugarcane, we find that the LUCI-LCA approach yields results opposite to those of standard LCA for greenhouse gas emissions and water consumption, and of different magnitudes for soil erosion and biodiversity. This approach highlights the importance of including information about where and how land-use change and related impacts will occur in supply chain and innovation decisions.
abstract_zh: 在日益全球化的经济中，跨国企业通过其产品设计和原料采购决策，对地球的土地利用和资源产生重大影响。许多企业使用生命周期评价（LCA）来评估其可持续性，但常用的LCA方法缺乏空间分辨率和预测性的生态信息，难以揭示对气候、水和生物多样性的关键影响。我们提出了LCA的改进方法，将空间显式的土地变化与生态系统服务建模相结合，即土地利用变化改进型LCA（LUCI-LCA）。通过比较两种不同原料区位情景下（玉米与甘蔗）生物塑料需求增长的影响，我们发现，LUCI-LCA方法在温室气体排放和水资源消耗方面得出的结果与标准LCA相反，而在土壤侵蚀和生物多样性方面的影响程度则有所不同。该方法凸显了在供应链和创新决策中纳入以下信息的重要性：土地利用变化及相关影响将在何处、以何种方式发生。
